headline: A bigger surprise means a wider first 30 minutes in the home currency (+9.9% from a 0.5-sigma to a 2-sigma miss, all 8 economies alike) and in gold on US releases (+9.0%), beyond the production forecast and event multiplier. By 2 h it is a few percent (context); by the session close it is gone. NQ and the S&P 500 show no material size effect.
